adopted_answer_or_rubric_verbatim: 说明无法确认本科课程研究海报所在大学，不能直接挪用论文研究会议地点。
english_rubric: The university for an undergraduate-course research poster cannot be established solely from the thesis-conference evidence. Do not automatically transfer Harvard to an unverified undergraduate-course event. The relationship between the events needs independent review.
